summary: UI list combo-box buffer constructor. Allocates a 116-byte state buffer through the sub-allocator vtable at this+0x4 and stores it at this+0x184, seeds it with function pointers (InitAndChain, ProtocolStateHandler) and a zeroed field, then branches on the a2 mode flag. Copy mode walks the sprite descriptor array at this+0xC4 (gated on count this+0x20, tripling element width when flag this+0xC8 is set), computes AlignUp dimensions, allocates one per-object buffer per element through vtable entry 5, stores the results in the buffer's output array at +18, and points the buffer's fourth slot at that array. Compositing mode instead allocates a flat 1280-byte buffer through vtable entry 1 and fills ten 128-byte strided pointers starting at buffer+8. Returns the output-array pointer in copy mode and the flat buffer base (advanced by ten strides) in compositing mode. Called by sub_516C7B.

local_names.a1: parent UI object carrying the sub-allocator vtable at +0x4, descriptor count at +0x20, descriptor array at +0xC4, flag at +0xC8, and the stored state buffer pointer at +0x184
local_names.a2: mode flag: non-zero selects per-object copy mode, zero selects flat compositing mode
local_names.v5: walking pointer over the sprite descriptor array elements
local_names.v17: iteration counter compared against the descriptor count
